definition: Impossible to understand, influence, or affect through ordinary means.
author: Jane Austen
quote: To hear those beautiful lines which have frequently almost driven me wild, pronounced with such impenetrable calmness, such dreadful indifference!"
example_sentence: The legal jargon was completely impenetrable.
